supersedes_clause_scope: HENGCE_RESEARCH_FRONTIER_DECISION_20261026 results/governance for X12, V43 and W1 active-frontier status

basis.user_practicality_requirement: A strategy that executes only three times in six months is not sufficiently actionable for the active HENGCE research frontier.

X12.reason: Only three executed operations in six months. Numerical profitability is insufficient to justify retention given the explicit practicality/frequency requirement.

V43.reason: Six-month 50% win rate and remove-best P/L below zero; profit concentrated in one trade.

W1_WIDE_TAIL.reason: Fails locked >=65% win-rate requirement at 40bp and the most recent three-month window is negative.

future_research_rule: Any replacement must be a new preregistered challenger/version. Retired X12, V43, and W1 may not regain active status merely by re-presenting old backtest results.
